spec.title: Nodes
spec.description: All nodes ever registered on the fleet.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",

  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0 
    WHEN t.time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END AS "Status",

  t.time AS "Last Seen",

  d.location AS "Location",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",

  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version",

  d.created_at AS "Date Registered",
  d.updated_at AS "Last Updated"

FROM devices d

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    sub.time,
    sub.metrics->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry sub
  WHERE sub.id = d.id
  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true;

spec.title: TDS & Temperature Avg.
spec.description: The average TDS and water temperature measurements within the selected timeframe. Color represents nothing.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),

  AVG(NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric) AS "TDS",

  AVG(NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature', '')::numeric) AS "Temperature"

FROM device_telemetry

WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

spec.title: TDS Value Distribution
spec.description: Displays the frequency distribution of Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) values in ppm across all nodes within the selected timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric AS "TDS"
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time);

spec.title: Location
spec.description: Nodes location based on registered data, color represents node's status.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.latitude,
  d.longitude,
  d.latitude || ', ' || d.longitude AS "Coordinates",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",
  d.created_at AS "Date Registered",
  d.updated_at AS "Last Updated",
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END AS "Status",
  t.time AS "Last Seen",
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    sub.time,
    sub.metrics->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry sub
  WHERE sub.id = d.id
    AND sub.time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval
  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true;

spec.title: Top 10 Nodes by Average TDS
spec.description: Displays the top 10 registered devices with the highest average Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) values in ppm, calculated within the selected timeframe. Used to identify locations with consistently high mineral or pollutant levels.

spec.rawSql:
WITH ranked_devices AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS "ID",
    d.name AS "Name",
    d.location AS "Location",

    AVG(
      NULLIF(t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric
    ) AS "Avg. TDS"

  FROM devices d

  INNER JOIN device_telemetry t 
    ON d.id = t.id

  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time)

  GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.location
)

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "Avg. TDS" DESC) AS "#",
  "Name",
  "Location",
  "ID",
  "Avg. TDS"

FROM ranked_devices

WHERE "Avg. TDS" IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY "Avg. TDS" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Overall Avg. TDS
spec.description: Calculates the global average of Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) in ppm across all active nodes within the selected timeframe. The panel color dynamically changes based on water drinkability standards according to standare Chelsa.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),

  AVG(
    NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric
  ) AS "TDS"

FROM device_telemetry

WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

spec.title: Last TDS Map
spec.description: Geomap showing the latest actual TDS levels and the exact time of the last measurement for each active node.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  t.tds AS "TDS",
  t.last_seen AS "Last Measurement",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",
  d.latitude AS "latitude",
  d.longitude AS "longitude"

FROM devices d

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    NULLIF(sub.metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric AS tds,
    sub.time AS last_seen

  FROM device_telemetry sub

  WHERE sub.id = d.id

  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true

WHERE t.tds IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: Temperature Value Distribution
spec.description: Displays the frequency distribution of water temperature values in Celsius across all nodes within the selected timeframe.

spec.title: Top 10 Nodes by Average Temperature
spec.description: Displays the top 10 registered devices with the highest average water temperature values in Celsius, calculated within the selected timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
WITH ranked_devices AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS "ID",
    d.name AS "Name",
    d.location AS "Location",

    AVG(
      NULLIF(t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature', '')::numeric
    ) AS "Avg. Temperature"

  FROM devices d

  INNER JOIN device_telemetry t
    ON d.id = t.id

  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time)

  GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.location
)

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "Avg. Temperature" DESC) AS "#",
  "Name",
  "Location",
  "ID",
  "Avg. Temperature"

FROM ranked_devices

WHERE "Avg. Temperature" IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY "Avg. Temperature" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Overall Avg.Temperature
spec.description: Calculates the global average of water temperature in Celsius across all active nodes within the selected timeframe. The panel color dynamically changes based on water drinkability comfort standards according to U. S. EPA.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),

  AVG(
    NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature', '')::numeric
  ) AS "Temperature"

FROM device_telemetry

WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

spec.title: Last Temperature Map
spec.description: Geomap showing the latest actual temperature of each active node within the selected timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  t.temperature AS "Temperature",
  t.last_seen AS "Last Measurement",

  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",

  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",
  d.latitude AS "latitude",
  d.longitude AS "longitude"

FROM devices d

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    NULLIF(
      sub.metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature',
      ''
    )::numeric AS temperature,

    sub.time AS last_seen

  FROM device_telemetry sub

  WHERE sub.id = d.id
    AND sub.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true

WHERE t.temperature IS NOT NULL;
